LANDING.META_TITLE: Avera Capital Access — Climate Finance Advisory

HERO.TITLE: Bridging global capital to high-impact sustainable projects.
HERO.SUB: Expert guidance for public and private organizations to secure Green Climate Fund (GCF) accreditation and funding.

METHOD.TITLE: Our results-driven methodology.
METHOD.LEDE: Four disciplined workstreams that move institutions from structural gaps to GCF-approved funding — with a clear deliverable at every stage.
METHOD.CARD1_BODY: A forensic gap analysis across fiduciary standards, environmental and social safeguards, gender policy and monitoring capacity.
METHOD.CARD2_BODY: Precise GCF alignment: entity positioning, accreditation pathway design and a board-ready sequencing plan.
METHOD.CARD3_BODY: Proposal engineering, project design, co-financing structure and submission management through technical review.
METHOD.CARD4_BODY: A dedicated long-term advisory desk for portfolio monitoring, compliance and successive funding cycles.

EDGE.TITLE: Structural precision, end to end.
EDGE.LEDE: We do not simply advise. We engineer the institutional and financial architecture that makes climate projects fundable.
EDGE.STEP1_BODY: We benchmark your institution against GCF fiduciary and environmental standards, closing gaps before formal review.
EDGE.STEP2_BODY: We engineer the accreditation package and shepherd it through the Fund's technical and independent review.
EDGE.STEP3_BODY: We structure bankable projects, align co-financing and prepare the dossier for Board approval.

REACH.LEDE: From ministries of finance to regional development banks, Avera works where policy, capital and climate outcomes intersect.
REACH.NOTE: Representative engagements. Client names withheld under advisory confidentiality.
REACH.QUOTE1_TEXT: Avera turned a two-year accreditation maze into a structured nine-month pathway. Their gap analysis was the turning point for our institution.
REACH.QUOTE2_TEXT: Their structural review gave our board the confidence to pursue GCF accreditation at scale — with a clear view of every compliance requirement.
REACH.QUOTE3_TEXT: The most precise climate finance advisory team we have worked with. Rigorous, discreet and genuinely focused on impact.

PORTAL.TITLE: Access your PATH to funding.
PORTAL.LEDE: One secure workspace for documents, accreditation milestones and direct advisory. Every requirement, every deadline, in view.
PORTAL.ITEM1: Secure document vault with audit trail
PORTAL.ITEM2: Live accreditation status and milestone tracking
PORTAL.ITEM3: Direct channel to your dedicated advisory desk
PORTAL.MOCK_LOGIN_SUB: Secure access to your accreditation workspace.

READINESS.TITLE: Structure a Readiness proposal GCF can actually review.
READINESS.LEDE: A guided seven-step intake for unaccredited organizations pursuing GCF Readiness 2024–2027. Build the logframe, trace every cost to an activity, run the FMCA fiduciary check and export a clean JSON package.
READINESS.ITEM1: Eligibility, NDA focal point and Readiness objective alignment
READINESS.ITEM2: Accreditation gap matrix across fiduciary, ESS and gender pillars
READINESS.ITEM3: Outcome → output → activity logframe with a Q1–Q8 Gantt
READINESS.ITEM4: Activity-linked budget with live PMC, audit and variance guardrails
READINESS.ITEM5: Conditional FMCA due diligence with a live fiduciary risk rating
READINESS.ITEM6: Statutory PDF vault, final checklist and GCF-ready JSON export
READINESS.NOTE: 7 steps · autosaves in your browser · no account required

CONTACT.TITLE: Readiness or accreditation? Ask before you commit.
CONTACT.LEDE: Most institutions are not sure which route fits their current capacity. Readiness builds the policies and systems you are missing; accreditation is the long-term status that follows. Tell us where you stand and we will tell you which one to pursue first.
CONTACT.ITEM1: A confidential read on your eligibility for either pathway
CONTACT.ITEM2: A clear comparison of cost, timeline and institutional effort
CONTACT.ITEM3: An honest answer on whether you are ready for accreditation yet
CONTACT.PATHWAY_A_BODY: A targeted grant to close fiduciary, ESS and gender gaps, then prepare a fundable project pipeline.
CONTACT.PATHWAY_A_ITEM1: For unaccredited national, private or civil society entities
CONTACT.PATHWAY_A_ITEM3: Fastest route to a first GCF-funded engagement
CONTACT.PATHWAY_B_BODY: Direct Access Entity status: your institution manages GCF funds and larger investment projects itself.
CONTACT.PATHWAY_B_ITEM1: Requires board-approved policies and clean external audits
CONTACT.PATHWAY_B_ITEM2: Undergoes the FMCA and full accreditation review
CONTACT.PATHWAY_B_ITEM3: Usually sequenced after a Readiness grant
CONTACT.NOTE_PANEL: Not sure which applies? Send one paragraph about your organization and we will map both routes for you.

FINAL.TITLE: Ready to structure your climate finance pathway?
FINAL.BODY: Begin with a confidential initial assessment. We will map your institutional readiness and outline the fastest credible route to GCF funding.
